title: Minimax Optimality of the Probability Flow ODE for Diffusion Models
tldr_zh: 次高斯+β-Hölder(β≤2) 密度下，软阈值高斯核 score 估计器+PF-ODE 采样器 TV 误差 Õ(n^{-β/(d+2β)})，确定性采样器首次（近）minimax（预印本）
tldr_en: Preprint: a soft-thresholded Gaussian-kernel score estimator controlling both L2 and Jacobian error makes the PF-ODE sampler near-minimax in TV, rate n^{-β/(d+2β)}, for subgaussian β-Hölder (β≤2) targets.
key_numbers: E[TV(p_Y,p*)] ≤ C n^{-β/(d+2β)} (log n)^{(d+1)/2} log K, for K ≥ n^{β/(d+2β)} log³K (Thm 1, Eq. 21)
ODE convergence: E[TV] ≲ d log⁴K/K + ε_sc √d log^{3/2}K + ε_jcb d log K (Thm 2, Eq. 34)
Per-t L2 score error ≤ (C_d/n)(1/t + σ^d/t^{d/2+1})(log n)^{d/2+1}, C_d=(4/√π)^d (Prop. 1, Eq. 37)
Initial smoothing bias TV ≤ C₂(1−ᾱ₁+τ)^{β/2∧1} log^{d/2}(·) (Prop. 3, Eq. 43); τ = n^{-2/(d+2β)}
